mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST declines by more than 5% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment conducive to equity investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2% each in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the specified direction.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals a supportive monetary policy in a growing economy, which boosts corporate investments and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases > 0.5% in 1 quarter
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when both FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases by more than 0.5% in a quarter.
